host: An original, fictional host portrayed as Beethoven: a thoughtful, curious musician. Warm mid-to-low register, textured and articulate, lightly theatrical but never pompous. No accent imitation; a modern, clear voice.

cues.direction: Start softly, close to the microphone. A tiny smile in 'the Earth itself'. Breathe before the reveal.

phrases.text: Welcome.
Today we have a new kind of orchestra…
the Earth itself.
I will only point the way. The planet does the playing.

cues.direction: An invitation, not a command. Let 'anywhere' breathe.

phrases.text: We could begin anywhere.
For our first performance, let's follow a line through the ocean.

cues.direction: Quick, warm acknowledgement that the visitor chose.

phrases.text: The ocean it is.

cues.direction: Quick, warm acknowledgement that the visitor chose.

phrases.text: A year in one place.
A fine choice.

cues.direction: Slightly slower. Give the listener room to hear the first sound.

phrases.text: Follow the path.
Each stop becomes a note,
and every note can lead us back to a place.
Listen.

cues.direction: Slow and settled; the visitor is staying still while time moves.

phrases.text: Now we stay in one place,
and let the months move around us.
Every sixteen days a satellite looks down, and each look becomes a note.
Listen.

cues.direction: Short pause before 'There.' Do not oversell it.

phrases.text: There.
Did you hear the turn?
Look at the highlighted note.
It came from this point on Earth.

cues.direction: Less drama. Speak the coordinates, units and the date accurately.

phrases.text: Stop nine: thirty-nine point nine degrees north, fifty-nine point five west.
On the eighteenth of August, two thousand and seven, the sea surface measured twenty-three point seven degrees Celsius,
down from twenty-eight point three at the stop before.
The sound is artistic. The number behind it is not invented.

cues.direction: Less drama. Speak the dates and NDVI values accurately.

phrases.text: The window from the twenty-sixth of June to the eleventh of July, twenty twenty-three.
Greenness rose from zero point three three to zero point five seven.
Seen from orbit, these Nile Delta fields grew green again.
The sound is artistic. The number behind it is not invented.
The panel shows the exact measurement,
its date, and the place it came from.
The sound is artistic. The number behind it is not invented.
Let's hear the rest.

cues.direction: Gentle smile, a subtle lift in the final phrase.

phrases.text: My turn is over.
Now the baton is yours.
Choose a place, draw a route, or listen to another year.

cues.direction: A warm sense of completion, not a game-show victory.

phrases.text: A record unlike any other.
Earth provided the pattern.
You chose where to listen.
